info.title: DigitalHeat API
info.description: Backend of the DigitalHeat platform: servers in building basements run AI jobs and their heat warms the building through a tank. WebSocket: `/api/v1/ws?token=<token>` (see docs/BACKEND_HANDOFF.md).

get.summary: Everything a client needs to configure itself
GeoJSON of all sites with live state

get.description: scope=fleet (default) or scope=site&siteId=H1; optional from/to (ISO) limit the period.

get.summary: One site + live state + today's KPIs
Slot readings of a site (live run so far)
get.description: resolution=15m|1h|1d|1mo: kWh fields summed, tank = last value, power = mean.

get.summary: Servers of a site + current tasks
All servers (for map rings / rack views)

post.description: pause = hold (not scheduled from the next slot), resume = release the hold, cancel = stop now.

get.summary: Customers with job counts and revenue

put.summary: Change algorithm, clock speed (slotSeconds) or pause / resume the clock

post.summary: Fast-forward the live run to a date (forward only, runs in the background)
post.description: Poll GET /admin/scheduler: mode is 'jumping' until done. Jumping a whole year takes ~1-2 min.

post.summary: Restart the live run from the first slot (reloads the input files)

get.summary: Real laptops (agents): host, CPU, real processes and their progress
Yearly balance per site and fleet from the last offline run (must-have 3)
Year timeline of the last offline run for one site (for yearly charts)
Every assumption with value, source and status (BRIEF / SOURCE / ASSUMPTION / MOCK / LIMIT)
Prices used for the money KPIs

post.summary: Submit a job (one or more tasks)
post.description: Arrives now (simulated time). Task ids are local to the request and made unique.

get.summary: One of my jobs with its tasks
Tasks of my job + lifecycle events
Server-hours and cost per month and priority
Heat my compute delivered to buildings
Heat by day / week / month / year
Value of the server heat per month

deadlineInMin.title: Deadlineinmin
deadlineInMin.description: Deadline in minutes of simulated time from now

slotSeconds.title: Slotseconds
slotSeconds.description: Real seconds per 15-min slot of the demo clock

paused.title: Paused
paused.description: True = stop the clock, False = let it run

datasetId.title: Datasetid
datasetId.description: File name from GET /admin/datasets; default = active file

taskId.title: Taskid
taskId.description: Your own id inside this job (e.g. 'T1'); made unique by the API

interruptible.title: Interruptible
interruptible.description: False = once started it cannot be paused or moved

dependsOn.title: Dependson
dependsOn.description: taskIds of this job that must finish first
